name: Sierra
foundedNote: Founded in 2023 by Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. No state incorporation filing is publicly retrievable — Sierra appears never to have filed a Form D, California's registry is behind bot protection, and Delaware's is captcha-gated. Forbes and Sequoia both say only '2023'; Contrary says March 2023 and Sacra says June 2023, neither citing a filing. Dated to the year rather than inventing a month. Anchors that are precise: Taylor's Salesforce resignation was announced 2022-11-30, Bavor's Google departure 2023-02-08, and the company launched publicly 2024-02-13.

events.nameConflict: Reported as both a seed and a Series A. Sierra has never used a series letter publicly.
events.note: Sierra never confirmed a valuation for this round. The ~$1B figure traces to a January 2024 Bloomberg report that the company was SEEKING funds at almost $1B, not to a closed price. Plotted hollow.
Crunchbase records Sequoia as the lead; TechCrunch and SiliconANGLE both name Greenoaks alone, with ICONIQ and Thrive participating.

events.nameConflict: Called Series D by some outlets and Series E by others.
events.note: Sierra said only 'over $15 billion'. Axios Pro, Quartz and Sacra independently report $15.8B post-money, so the specific multi-source figure is used. The sierra/ timeline tool in this repo deliberately records the conservative $15B floor instead — a difference in sourcing policy, not an error.

curatorNotes: No inter-round valuation marks exist. Sierra has never run a reported tender offer or company-sponsored secondary. Hiive ($67.27/share, 2026-08-04) and Notice.co ($54.03/share) publish indicative secondary prices, but these are platform estimates with no disclosed share count and cannot be converted to a company valuation — excluded. SoftBank Vision Fund 2 made a strategic investment announced 2025-12-04 alongside the Japan expansion, with amount and valuation undisclosed — excluded. ARR for context: ~$26M end-2024, $100M Nov 2025, $150M Feb 2026, ~$200M May 2026.
unresolved: Legal incorporation date — no state filing or Form D is publicly retrievable.
